newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: SOCCER-10-MAN BULGARIA SQUEEZE OUT 2-1 WIN OVER LUXEMBOURG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-10-MAN BULGARIA SQUEEZE OUT 2-1 WIN OVER LUXEMBOURG.

text.p: Bulgaria, reduced to 10 men after an hour when substitute Ivan Vassilev was sent off, squeezed out a 2-1 win over Luxembourg on Tuesday to breathe new life into their World Cup qualifying campaign.

Bulgaria, badly in need of a win after losing their opening European group five qualifier to Israel last month, took the lead in the 14th minute when Krasimir Balakov converted a penalty after Emil Kostadinov was fouled.
Roby Langers equalised six minutes later with a low 10-metre shot which went in off the post.
But Kostadinov re-established Bulgaria's advantage with a clever lob from Yordan Lechkov's pass after 37 minutes.

Luxembourg took command after Vassilev was dismissed for felling Guy Hellers just outside the area -- he had come on for Georgi Antonov at the start of the second half -- but Bulgarian goalkeeper Borislav Mihailov produced three superb saves from Langers, Jeff Strasser and Hellers.

Luxembourg - 1-Paul Koch, 2-Jean Vanek, 3-Frank Deville, 4-Marc Birsens, 5-Jeff Strasser, 6-Jeff Saibene (16-Serge Thill 81st), 7-Guy Hellers, 8-Carlo Weis, 9-Roby Langers, 10-Manuel Cardoni (18-Dany Theis 28th), 11-Patrick Posing (15-Claude Ganser 46th)

Bulgaria - 1-Borislav Mihailov, 2-Georgi Antonov (13-Ivan Vassilev 46th), 3-Trifon Ivanov, 4-Tsanko Tsvetanov, 5-Radostin Kishishev, 6-Zlatko Yankov, 7-Emil Kostadinov, 8-Marian Hristov (14-Kostadin Vidolov 46th), 9-Yordan Lechkov, 10-Krasimir Balakov, 11-Georgi Ivanov (17-Daniel Borimirov 61st)
